question: Who among the following headed the National Income Committee?
solution:
The correct answer is P.C. Mahalanobis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

The National Income Committee, 1949

__
 
• After independence in **August 1949, **the government of India established the National Income Committee to compute the national income of the economy.
 
• **Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis **was the chairperson of the **National Income Committee.**
 
• **Prof. D.R. Gadgil** and **Dr. V.K.R.V. Rao** were also one of the **members of this committee.**
 
• The **first report **of the committee was presented in the year** 1951.**
 
• According to the first report, the national income of India for the year 1948-49 was **Rs. 8,710 crores** and the per capita income was** Rs. 225.**

Thus, the** first official attempt** to calculate the national Income of India in 1949 was made by National Income Committee that was headed by **Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**The Central Statistical Organisation (CSO)

 
• Since the year 1955, the national income estimates for India are being prepared by Central Statistical Organisation.
 
• The CSO uses different methods, i.e., product method, income method, and expenditure method to estimate the national income for different sectors of the economy.
